verdict.rationale: Adyen documents its own payment-links capability: 'Offer payment links,' and its MCP tools can create, get and expire payment links. That implies a vendor-hosted page customers can be sent to instead of a merchant-built payment UI. However, the evidence never describes a hosted checkout page, a redirect flow, or conversion optimization of that page. The sessions flow cited elsewhere sends payment data to the merchant's own client-side application rather than a hosted page. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a vendor-hosted checkout or redirect integration, evidence that the hosted page is conversion-optimized, details on customizing the hosted page, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI
